upstream.name: v0.9.5
upstream.body:
### Features - **about** Icons and even spacing for the update settings on the About page - **window** Pause live updates on desktop while the screen is asleep or locked - **update** Install macOS updates from inside the app - **proxies** Proxy groups unfold smoothly as one block - **connection** Connection, request, DNS, outbound IP and log details use smaller text with more room - **prism_ui** List rows follow a smaller text size, as they already did a larger one - **prism_ui** The phone tab bar spaces five tabs and sets out icons and labels as iOS does - **about** The automatic update check and the update channel moved from General settings to the About page - **logs** Filter logs from a button beside search - **logs** Set the log level from the Logs page - **requests** Connections become Requests: connections by minute with All, Active and Failed counts, conditions on app, exit, rule or protocol, a timeline for each connection, DNS queries, segments that keep their place, and new rows held under a desktop pointer - **update** Choose between stable and prerelease updates in the settings; the prerelease check finds the newest release and names the installed prerelease - **ui** Lists and cards share one set of margins, so rows line up across pages - **dashboard** The dashboard's outbound mode card is titled Outbound, leaving its mode buttons more room - **ui** Grouped lists match iOS 27: row heights, margins, corners and section spacing - **logs** On desktop, Logs moves from the sidebar into Tools - **connections** Connections on macOS, Windows and Linux show the icon of the app that made them - **navigation** Requests sits right after Proxies in the desktop sidebar - **connections** Connections that failed to connect now show in the requests list, with the reason - **update** When an update has no file to download, the app opens the release page to download it by hand ### Bug Fixes - **proxies** A rounder, larger delay test icon on proxy cards - **prism_ui** Navigation bar tabs fit their titles, and a tap near a tab's edge selects it - **dashboard** Live connections on the dashboard open on the active ones - **rules** The rule type picker and rule lists show rule types as profiles write them, such as DOMAIN-KEYWORD, and rule search finds a rule by that name - **core** A stop whose answer is lost with the connection to the core no longer turns the proxy back on when the core comes back - **setup** Restarting the core with TUN on no longer hangs when it has to ask for authorization again - **core** On desktop, a restart asked for while the core is still starting, such as after installing the helper, now restarts it, and the core can start again after a start whose local connection setup hung - **core** On Android, stopping while the core is still starting no longer leaves it running, and a start that failed while sending settings to the core no longer blocks the next start - **probes** Recheck watched service failures with backoff - **probes** Service checks recover automatically when a chain switches to a working front proxy - **setup** Dashboard checks wait for startup to finish when you tap Start as the app opens - **l10n** Shorter descriptions in network, DNS and general settings - **segmented-control** Segmented controls follow the system's reduce motion setting - **connected-button** Screen readers can now switch the dashboard's outbound mode - **scaffold** On wider phones the top bar buttons line up with the list cards below them - **scaffold** Opening search puts the cursor in its field even when something else on the page has the focus - **android** App icons in access control and connections load from the cache instead of being redrawn every day - **core** On macOS, connections show the app that opened them again - **window** A hidden window no longer takes the foreground from a full-screen game on Windows - **linux** The Linux window is no longer drawn shifted toward the bottom left on NVIDIA and other drivers without glBlitFramebuffer - **tray** When the menu bar or tray icon cannot be shown, the log says why - **macos** Intel Macs render with Skia again, fixing the hang at launch on older GPUs - **dashboard** Service checks show the address Claude and ChatGPT actually saw, not only the node's exit address - **core** Gemini check no longer reports Hong Kong and Macau nodes as unsupported - **core** macOS no longer collects defunct dscacheutil processes each time TUN is turned on or off - **config** The default bypass list no longer skips the proxy for public 172.2* addresses, and the default fake-ip filter names Windows' real connectivity check hosts - **ui** Pages open and close again after the display sleeps or changes ### Performance - **code_forge** Large files open in the editor without a pause - **db** Profiles with many rules, groups or proxies open and update without stalling the screen - **route** Pages that load their data open at once with a spinner instead of pausing before they slide in - **android** Use less battery on Android in the background - **ui** Open list editors and pages over others more smoothly - **dashboard** Smoother dashboard and tab switches, with one redraw a second while connected - **proxies** Smoother proxy pages when switching groups, sorting and scrolling - **prism_ui** Swiping back on phones drops fewer frames
